name: Clash Of The Champions

date.source: The show's own posting date; its own subject line gives an on-air date of 4/6/97.

no_appearances_reason: The show's own five matches stage real, publicly-known professional wrestlers under their own names; per the packet's own thin-tag posture, no character rows are minted for the real-wrestler portrayals -- a pending-enrichment note, per the tier rule and the holdings bar (a future pass should mint under the per-promotion portrayal rule, per-fed, with external-figures edges).
notes: Five matches: Hayabusa defeated Rick Taylor in a Barbed Wire Thumbtack Deathmatch for the RFHW Extreme Championship (new champion); Disco Inferno defeated Jerry Flynn; The Sandman defeated Joel Gutman; "Kamikaze" Jack Atari defeated Sabu; a tag match (Heavy Metal defeated The Lone Gunmen); and a World Title Match (Ghost vs. Taz) that ends on a confused, unclear finish in the served text -- no title change is asserted for that bout. A scheduled TV Title match (Mr. Pogo vs. Doug Baxter) never started after ringside interference; the bout was ruled a count-out win for Pogo, no title change asserted.
